title: Quickly Indulgent Jamaican Sweet Potato Casserole
description: A malty, juicy, and indulgent Jamaican dish featuring dulce de leche, deglaze-fond, and ovo-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced sweet potatoes, brown sugar, allspice, and thyme, and toss to coat.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the dulce de leche, heavy cream, and eggs.
Add the melted butter, diced scotch bonnet peppers, and whisked dulce de leche mixture to the sweet potato mixture, and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the casserole is set and the top is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Deglaze the baking dish with a little water to loosen the fond and serve the casserole hot.
